families.prescribed_model: Having risen on the third day
Thou Who wast lifted up upon the Cross
Having laid aside all earthly hope
Let us assemble with the disciples
Great is the power of Thy martyrs
O Thou Who hast adorned heaven with stars
Disdaining the image made by hands
In the Spirit in the sanctuary
When the stone had been sealed
Let us go up with the disciples
What shall we call you, O holy ones
Beholding the beauty of thy virginity
Let us go up with the disciples
While the soldiers were guarding Thy tomb
Great is the power of Thy Cross, O Lord
In the spirit in the sanctuary
O Lord, though Thou didst stand before the tribunal
Rejoice, O Habitation of the Ascetics
